title: pycnandra intermedia
intro: Pycnandra intermedia, commonly known as the Pandanus, is a plant species native to New Caledonia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pycnandra intermedia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and anticancer activities. However, further research is required to confirm the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
